Container.Name: plexgeo
Container.Overview: Stream intelligence dashboard for Plex — live world map, session logs, and anomaly alerts when users stream from unusual locations.
Container.Description: PlexGeo monitors your Plex server, logs every user stream by IP and country, graphs trends over time, and raises anomaly alerts when a user streams from an unusual location.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: URL of your Plex server, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:32400

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Encryption key for sensitive settings. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: Outlier Threshold
Config.Description: A country must account for less than this fraction of sessions to be flagged

Config.Name: Outlier Min Sessions
Config.Description: Minimum sessions before outlier detection kicks in
